{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically below true prices for first 10-15 days, showing significant lag behind price momentum",
    "Sentiment positively correlates with price increases but model under-forecasts the magnitude when sentiment is strong (0.67-1.00)",
    "Model overshoots prices after sustained declines, especially days 16-25 where true prices continue falling while model bottoms or reverses early",
    "Mean reversion bias: model fails to capture sustained price levels, constantly targeting values that are too close to recent averages",
    "When sentiment turns negative (0.00-0.33), model delays the forecast decline more than 3-5 days relative to true prices",
    "Price level bias: model under-forecasts when prices are below $70 and over-forecasts when prices are above $80, missing the true range of 66-84",
    "Sentiment lag: model uses current sentiment but true prices incorporate building sentiment shifts a few days earlier" ]
}
